name: Close-Auction Hedging Reversal
note: Measures the last half hour of the cash session -- rLH = log(close / the price 30 minutes earlier) -- and when its magnitude is in the top of the trailing 60-session distribution, takes the OPPOSITE side at the next session's open for a three-day hold. The premise is that a big closing move is dealer hedging pressure, not information, so it unwinds. Signals are placed on the last bar before the cash open so the fill lands on that open.
source: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (2021), JFE 142(1), 377-403 - the reversal test: 'in all four asset classes, returns in the next three days are opposite to those of rLH'.
code:
def _et_clock(bars):
    """Minutes after ET midnight and the ET calendar date for every bar.

    zoneinfo needs a tz database that Windows does not ship, so the US rule is
    applied directly: EDT (UTC-4) from the second Sunday of March 07:00 UTC to
    the first Sunday of November 06:00 UTC, EST (UTC-5) otherwise.
    """
    import datetime as dt
    mins = []
    days = []
    off_cache = {}
    for b in bars:
        s = str(b["t"])
        key = s[:13]
        off = off_cache.get(key)
        if off is None:
            u = dt.datetime(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10]), int(s[11:13]))
            mar = dt.datetime(u.year, 3, 8)
            mar = mar + dt.timedelta(days=(6 - mar.weekday()) % 7)
            mar = mar.replace(hour=7)
            nov = dt.datetime(u.year, 11, 1)
            nov = nov + dt.timedelta(days=(6 - nov.weekday()) % 7)
            nov = nov.replace(hour=6)
            off = 4 if (mar <= u < nov) else 5
            off_cache[key] = off
        hh = int(s[11:13]) - off
        d = s[0:10]
        if hh < 0:
            hh += 24
            d = (dt.date(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10]))
                 - dt.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
        mins.append(hh * 60 + int(s[14:16]))
        days.append(d)
    return mins, days


def family_init(ctx):
    """rLH = log(session close / the price `tail` minutes before it) -- the size
    of the closing hedging push. When |rLH| is in the top of its own trailing
    distribution, take the OTHER side at the next session's open and hold a few
    days, which is the reversal Baltussen et al. document.

    A daily bar cannot express this: close-relative-to-15:30 is invisible in
    OHLC, so the signal is read off intraday bars and the ET clock. The order
    is placed on the last bar before the cash open so it fills AT that open."""
    import math
    bars = ctx.bars
    m = len(bars)
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    mins, days = _et_clock(bars)

    cm = int(ctx.p.close_min)
    om = int(ctx.p.open_min)
    tl = int(ctx.p.tail_min)

    sess = [0] * m
    si = -1
    prev = None
    for i in range(m):
        if days[i] != prev:
            si += 1
            prev = days[i]
        sess[i] = si
    ns = si + 1

    cbar = [-1] * ns          # last bar of the cash session
    rbar = [-1] * ns          # the bar whose close is the reference price
    fo = [-1] * ns            # first bar of the cash session
    for i in range(m):
        s = sess[i]
        t = mins[i]
        if om <= t < cm:
            cbar[s] = i
            if fo[s] < 0:
                fo[s] = i
        if om <= t < cm - tl:
            rbar[s] = i

    rlh = [None] * ns
    for s in range(ns):
        a = rbar[s]
        b = cbar[s]
        if a >= 0 and b > a and c[a] > 0.0 and c[b] > 0.0:
            rlh[s] = math.log(c[b] / c[a])

    sig = [0] * m
    isc = [False] * m
    for s in range(ns):
        if cbar[s] >= 0:
            isc[cbar[s]] = True

    pl = max(5, int(ctx.p.plook))
    q = float(ctx.p.pct)
    mn = max(3, int(ctx.p.min_sess))
    for s in range(1, ns):
        j = fo[s]
        if j <= 0:
            continue
        k = j - 1                       # fills at the cash open of session s
        if cbar[s - 1] < 0 or k < cbar[s - 1]:
            continue
        r = rlh[s - 1]
        if r is None:
            continue
        hist = [abs(x) for x in rlh[max(0, s - pl):s] if x is not None]
        if len(hist) < mn:
            continue
        hist.sort()
        Q = hist[int(q * (len(hist) - 1))]
        if Q <= 0.0:
            continue
        if r >= Q:
            sig[k] = -1                 # fade the closing push up
        elif r <= -Q:
            sig[k] = 1
    ctx.sig = ctx.series(sig, "close_push")
    ctx.sess = ctx.series(sess, "session")
    ctx.isc = ctx.series(isc, "session_close")


def signal(ctx, i):
    return ctx.sig[i]


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Out at the close of the hold-th session after entry -- the window over
    which the paper measures the reversal."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    a = ctx.sess[ctx.positions[0]["entry_i"]]
    b = ctx.sess[i]
    if a is None or b is None:
        return False
    n = int(ctx.p.hold)
    if b - a > n:
        return True
    return b - a >= n and bool(ctx.isc[i])
